title: Mukundi Ari Pakati Pemafungiro Maviri
intro: Munhoroondo yenhungamiro yaMwari, mumwe munhu anomira akasiyana semutongi ane simba uye muranda waAllah anozvininipisa. Munhu uyu akafamba kusvika kure kure kwenyika, achiona zuva richibuda pavanhu vasina kujairika ndokunyura muchitubu chakasviba chine rima. Chinoshamisa ndechekuti, muranda uyu akapihwa basa rekuvaka rusvingo runoshamisa kubva kurudzi rwezvakaipa zvikuru. Unogona here kuziva munhu uyu wengano kubva muKorani?
clues: Ndakapiwa simba nepesvedzero panyika naIye Ane Ngoni Zvikuru
Ndakaenda kunzvimbo inobuda zuva uye kwarinonyura
Ndakarayirwa kuvaka rusvingo rukuru ndichishandisa simbi
Ndakavhara nzvimbo iri pakati pemakomo maviri akadzika nesimbi yakanyungudutswa
Ndakanga ndisiri ngirozi kana muporofita, asi muranda akapihwa nyasha naAllah

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
